Location: KluisbergenIndustry: Rubber ManufacturingWork Schedule: 2 shifts (early & late)
About the Company
We are a well-established rubber manufacturing company based in Kluisbergen, specialized in the production of high-quality rubber products for various industrial applications. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a motivated Production Operator to strengthen our team.
Your Responsibilities
• 
Operating and monitoring production machines

• 
Setting up machines according to production parameters

• 
Performing quality checks on finished products

• 
Identifying and reporting technical or production issues

• 
Ensuring a safe, clean, and organized working environment

• 
Working closely with colleagues and supervisors to meet production targets

• 
You have first experience as an operator in a production environment

• 
Technical insight and willingness to learn

• 
Ability to work accurately and independently

• 
Good understanding of safety and quality standards

• 
You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system

• 
Good knowledge of English (Dutch is a plus)

Ready to take charge of your own CNC machine and produce high-quality parts?

Your Responsibilities:

• Inspect and adjust first pieces as needed
• Move large workpieces using an overhead crane (certification is a plus, training can be provided internally)
• Work on a fixed machine and fully utilize your expertise
• Program directly at the machine
• Independently produce hydraulic components on CNC machines
• Read technical drawings and determine the optimal workflow

Your Profile:

• Read technical drawings and plan the machining sequence
• Experience with overhead cranes or willingness to learn
• Strict adherence to safety regulations
• Precise and skilled with measuring tools
• Able to program and set up machines independently
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French, or English
• Experience as a CNC milling operator or machinist

We’re looking for people who enjoy doing hands-on work!This position is with a company that specializes in ham production.The company is located in Oudenaarde and is looking for employees to work in two shifts.
What will your responsibilities be?

• Maintaining the machines, equipment, and the building itself
• Performing scheduled maintenance and repairs
• Ensuring the machines operate at peak performance

Who are you?

• You have experience performing maintenance work

Then we are looking for you!

For a company in Kluisbergen we are looking for a logistic operator. 

You will work in two shifts. 

• experience as forklift driver
• experience as operator
• good knowledge of English

BelPro Chocolate Masters is a growing chocolate manufacturer in Duffel. We are looking for a motivated recent graduate or junior professional who wants to develop practical experience in Quality & Food Safety within a real food-production environment. 
You will work closely with the Operations Manager and experienced external specialists. You will support the development and day-to-day maintenance of our Quality Management System (QMS), HACCP, GMP, hygiene and food-safety activities. 
Your activities will include supporting procedures and quality records, following up quality requirements on the production floor, traceability exercises, internal checks, non-conformities and corrective actions, internal audits, supplier and raw-material documentation, and preparation for future IFS Food certification. 
We are looking for someone with a background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. Previous food-industry experience is an advantage but is not required. 
Good English is important. Dutch is an advantage. 
We offer a practical opportunity to learn, contribute and gradually take on more responsibility as BelPro continues to grow.

• Background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. 
• Basic knowledge of HACCP, microbiology, food safety, quality systems or food processing is an advantage. 
• Structured, practical and willing to learn. 
• Comfortable working both with documentation and on the production floor. 
• Able to communicate and cooperate with production and management. 
• Previous food-manufacturing experience is an advantage, but not required.

JOB OVERVIEW

The SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Specialist will administer, improve and progressively develop KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.

You will work on our SharePoint intranet, Hub architecture, departmental Team Sites, document management, permissions and automation, while also supporting colleagues with existing SharePoint solutions.

The role combines hands-on technical work with business-process understanding. You will work closely with the allocated KOMIS Manager, Project Managers and users to translate operational needs into practical and maintainable Microsoft 365 solutions.

For someone who enjoys both technology and problem solving, this role offers considerable scope to shape solutions and see the direct impact of their work across the organisation.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SharePoint & Microsoft 365

• Administer, maintain and improve KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Support Project Managers and users with existing SharePoint sites and functionality.
• Configure and progressively develop the SharePoint Online intranet and Hub architecture.
• Create and maintain departmental SharePoint Team Sites connected to Microsoft Teams.
• Configure Hub navigation, Quick Links, News templates and aggregated news.
• Troubleshoot SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues and implement practical solutions.
Information, documents & access

• Configure document libraries, metadata, views and information structures.
• Support restructuring and migration of content from existing SharePoint sites.
• Manage Microsoft Entra ID security groups, permissions and access controls, including library-level permissions.
• Help maintain clear, secure and manageable access structures across SharePoint.
Automation & business solutions

• Develop SharePoint Lists and, progressively, Power Automate workflows and Power Apps where useful.
• Identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring business processes using Microsoft 365 tools.
Business support, testing & documentation

• Work with managers and users to understand business needs and translate them into practical Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Test new configurations and solutions before deployment.
• Document configurations, procedures and solutions and prepare user guidance where needed. 
QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

We are looking for someone who combines solid Microsoft 365 knowledge with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

You should have:

• At least 3 years of practical professional experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
• Solid knowledge of SharePoint sites, document libraries, permissions, metadata, views and Hub Sites.
• Experience integrating SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams.
• Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, security groups and access management.
• Practical experience with SharePoint Lists and Power Automate.
• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills.
• Good written and spoken English.
NICE TO HAVE

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage: Microsoft Power Apps; Microsoft Graph; PowerShell or PnP PowerShell; SharePoint governance; SharePoint migration tools; Microsoft 365 security and compliance; Broader Microsoft Power Platform solutions.

You do not need to bring all of these from day one. We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong SharePoint/Microsoft 365 foundation, sound judgement and willingness to develop further.
 
WHY JOIN US

This role offers the opportunity to have a visible impact on how KOMIS collaborates, manages information and uses technology across the organisation.

We offer:

• A role with real ownership and scope to shape solutions.
• The opportunity to develop a modern SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Exposure to different teams, business processes and international projects.
• A collaborative environment where initiative and practical ideas are encouraged.
• Brussels-based hybrid working arrangement.
At KOMIS, we value practical solutions, continuous improvement and people who take ownership of their work.

• Willingness to perform physical work.

• You are looking for a long-term job.
• You live close to Zulte or you have a car
• You are motivated and enjoy working in a team.

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!
 

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.
 

 
 

Position overview:
 

 
 

An Electrical & Auxillary Supervisor is responsible for leading a team of electrical and maintenance shop team members, managing the life cycle of all support equipment and electrical resources, including execution of maintenance, process improvement and contracting with outside services. This role ensures the reliable and efficient operation of all electrical systems and support equipment within the plant. This role leads a team of electricians and maintenance specialists that focuses on maximizing production throughput, minimizing downtime, and sustaining high equipment availability by leading maintenance activities, troubleshooting electrical and mechanical issues, and implementing proactive improvement strategies. The supervisor drives operational excellence while ensuring safety, compliance, and optimal resource utilization across the plant.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Maintain all electrical systems and auxiliary equipment to ensure high uptime, production throughput, and minimal downtime 

• Lead, coach, and develop electricians and maintenance specialists, ensuring a skilled, high-performing team 

• Plan, prioritize, and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities 

• Ensure all work is performed safely and in compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and food safety standards 

• Identify and implement initiatives to improve equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness 

• Rapidly diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical problems to minimize production interruptions 

• Manage personnel, tools, materials, and external contractors effectively to meet operational goals 

• Maintain accurate maintenance logs, equipment records, SOPs, and performance metrics 

• Drive continuous improvement, ensuring optimal utilization of resources and alignment with plant objectives 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, support equipment, conveyance systems 

• Job related experience in an industrial environment with the focus on electrical, mechanical or maintenance role 

• Working knowledge of automation & controls 

• Ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex electrical and mechanical issues 

• Strong knowledge of plant electrical systems, auxiliary equipment, controls, and associated mechanical systems 

• Problem solving, trouble shooting and process improvement skills 

• Project management support for plant capital improvements, line speed alterations, conveyance changes and safety iniatives 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English 

• Leads, coaches, and develops a high-performing maintenance and electrical team  

 
 

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles solutions that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.
 

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.
 

Please note the advertised job title might vary from the job title on the contract due to local job title structure and global HR systems. 
 

No agencies please.

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

As a reach truck driver, you are one of the most important links in the Katoen Natie warehouse in Ghent. You are responsible for storing and preparing valuable materials. Using the reach truck, you regularly stock goods on high racks. This requires an eye for detail and safety.

 

Profile

• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

• You work 60% on the reachtruck and 40% other tasks in the warehouse

• You ideally have extensive experience with the reach truck (at least 1 year); a certificate is a plus, but not a must

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, it is important that you speak and understand Dutch or English or French

• You start in a day shift for training and then fulltime night shift

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.

• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.

• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.

• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.

• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.

 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.

• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.

• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.

• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.

• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.

• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.

• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.

• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift

• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.

• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.

• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.

• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.

• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.

• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

For a fast-growing manufacturing company, we are looking for a hands-on ERP Application Manager.
The group will implement a new ERP package (MS Dynamics F&O) and want to attract someone who will lead this project.
 

In this key role, the application manager will act as the bridge between the needs of their business departments and the ERP solution, ensuring seamless implementation across the organization.
 

This is a job on-site in Tournai with travel to their production site in France from time to time.
 

Functie
 
 

• Understand and analyze the current systems (own build applications) to identify opportunities for improvement. 

• Collaborate with departments (production, logistics, finance, etc.) to gather their needs and ensure they are reflected in the ERP system. 

• Lead the ERP implementation, introducing modules step by step while ensuring strong alignment across internal teams. 

• Direct the software partner and other external consultants. 

• Evaluate and optimize current processes to improve efficiency, standardization, and flexibility. 

• Identify custom needs and differentiate ERP functions from other tools (e.g., WMS, MES, BI). 

• You give support and training to the users. 

• Define user roles and access levels, as well as onboarding procedures for new employees. 
 

• At least 3 years of experience implementing ERP systems (SAP, D365, or equivalent). 

• A solid understanding of software environments (ERP, WMS, CMMS, MES, CRM, HR systems). 

• Experience in the food industry or knowledge of traceability systems (a plus). 

• Project management expertise: Familiarity with principles and methodologies to manage ERP rollout projects. 

• Strong problem-solving skills to handle technical challenges quickly and effectively. 

• Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. 

• A detail-oriented mindset to ensure system accuracy and data integrity.  
 

• You’re independent, a great team player, and excel in building connections. 

• Dynamic, proactive and curious. 

• Fluency in English. Knowledge of French and Dutch is a plus.
